headlines.text: Turning the clock back to 2022: Bryan Danielson vs. Chris Jericho met in a Tournament Match, closing out the card as the main event on Dynamite, rated 8.29 ? one of the better matches of the year. Jericho targeted Danielson's freshly injured ankle with a ring-post assault, but Danielson fought back and locked in the LeBell Lock to force the tap ? the first time he'd ever beaten Jericho.

2022 brought us this moment: Samoa Joe vs. Josh Woods fought tooth and nail for the ROH World TV Title, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.24. For Josh Woods, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. Every title match carries a little extra weight, and this one was no exception.
Back on this day in 2022, Serena Deeb was back in action after 2 months away, appearing on Dynamite.

secondaries.text: It was 2022 when Swerve in our Glory vs. The Lucha Brothers put the AEW World Tag Team Titles on the line, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.13 ? a good, competitive contest.
That Wednesday in 2022, Willow Nightingale stepped back through the curtain after just under 2 months away, appearing on Rampage.
Looking back to 2022, when it was a welcome sight as Matt Hardy returned to the ring after 6 weeks away, appearing on Rampage.
